notes:
Every page is now read panel by panel.

Read-along used to work down a page by height, which meant two panels side by side had their balloons shuffled into each other — you'd hear half of one man's sentence, then half of the other's. Pages are now followed panel by panel, in the page's own direction, the way you read them.

• Sentences split across balloons come out whole instead of in pieces.
• Japanese pages read right to left properly, including double-page spreads.
• Webtoons and manhwa are unchanged — they already read straight down.
• Two stacked balloons that make up one line now share one voice.

Pages you've already prepared will be re-read once, so they pick up the new order.
